title: postapiauthregisterwithvalidandinvaliddata
description: Test user registration endpoint POST /api/auth/register with valid data to ensure user creation returns 201 and with invalid or incomplete data to verify it returns 400 validation error.

title: postapiauthloginwithvalidandinvalidcredentials
description: Test user login endpoint POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials to receive 200 and JWT token, and with invalid credentials to receive 401 unauthorized response.

title: getapiticketslistwithrolebasedfiltering
description: Test GET /api/tickets/list with valid JWT token to verify role-based ticket listing: users see own tickets, agents see assigned tickets, admins see all tickets.

title: getapiticketsidwithpermissionchecks
description: Test GET /api/tickets/:id to retrieve ticket details when user has permission (200) and to receive 403 or 404 when accessing tickets outside permission scope.

title: postapiticketscreateandputapiticketsidwithrolebasedupdates
description: Test POST /api/tickets/create with valid data to create tickets and PUT /api/tickets/:id to update tickets with role-based field restrictions, ensuring users cannot update restricted fields like status or priority.

title: patchapiticketsidassignanddeleteapiticketsidwithrolepermissions
description: Test PATCH /api/tickets/:id/assign as admin to assign tickets to agents and DELETE /api/tickets/:id as admin to delete tickets; verify non-admins receive 403 forbidden for these actions.

title: getapiauthusersputapiauthusersidanddeleteapiauthusersidasadminandnonadmin
description: Test admin-only user management endpoints GET /api/auth/users, PUT /api/auth/users/:id, and DELETE /api/auth/users/:id to ensure admins can manage users and non-admins receive 403 forbidden.

title: frontendloginregisterandticketdashboardflows
description: Test frontend React pages for /login and /register including form validation, successful login and registration flows, JWT token handling, and protected /tickets dashboard rendering with role-based ticket data.
